integrity: The source full paper was examined at definitions of sample covariance, active pairs, nonlinear optimization, ridge safeguard and its rank discussion; a relevant primary Mahalanobis-depth imputation predecessor was separately examined at its regression-imputation characterization. The proof is an explicit trace identity and binomial limit argument; a bundled standalone computation checks a full-column-rank counterexample. Source publication timestamps differ across repositories; the earliest explicit public date listed is 15 May 2026.
scientific_limitations: Flatness concerns the exact unregularized active-pair objective with sample covariance recalculated from the completed matrix, only for completions with nonsingular covariance.
At most one complete row is sufficient but is not established as necessary for other failure modes.
Ridge penalization yields a nonconstant covariance-spectrum functional and does not satisfy the flatness theorem.
Independent per-cell MCAR is required for the sharp mask-probability statement; no direct assertion is made about the source low-dimensional experimental sample.
title: No-complete-pair flatness and its MCAR threshold in covariance-updated Mahalanobis imputation
